target: 100% completion on the chosen 2019 Windows PC remaster route

areas.name: Windows PC Remaster Setup
areas.location_cue: The profile, loadout, character, and difficulty menus before entering any map.
areas.note: This route uses the 2019 Windows remaster; its bundled challenge missions, weapons, characters, photo mode, co-op, and competitive modes are all in scope.

items.label: Complete every campaign map on Sniper Elite difficulty

levels.1: Use the preset that enables the complete ballistic model.
levels.2: Select Sniper Elite before each campaign or challenge-map launch.
levels.3: Clear all eleven campaign maps and all four challenge maps with Sniper Elite selected. Do not switch to Custom mid-map; Mission Select may be used for individual replays, and two-player campaign also permits this preset in the remaster.

levels.1: The remaster added a full alternate-character roster.
levels.2: Open character selection before a map and rotate away from the default model.
levels.3: Launch and finish at least one map as Karl Fairburne, Dr. Efram Schweiger, Marie Chevalier, Hermann Wolff, Hanna Schulz, Beth Coleman, Boris Medvedev, and Anya Bochkareva. There are eight selectable characters in total: the original lead plus seven additions.

items.label: Use every Photo Mode control group

levels.1: The remaster can freeze more than a still camera does.
levels.2: Pause during gameplay and open Photo Mode from the pause menu.
levels.3: Freeze a live scene, step the action by at least one frame, move and rotate the free camera, change a filter, alter the lighting controls, and save a local capture. No guide image is supplied or required; this checklist only records use of the built-in feature.

save_backup.detail: Copy the local profile after the solo campaign and collectibles are complete; keep that copy until every co-op and competitive row is checked.

Collect the Mosin-Nagant from the supplied table in Kaiser-Friedrich Museum, then take the Gewehr 43 from the supply drop near the top of St. Olibartus Church; both remain selectable afterward. The remaster's bundled set also provides the Karabiner 98k, SVT-40, Lee-Enfield No.4, Type 99, M1 Carbine, and M1D Garand. Fire and reload all nine rifles during live maps.

levels.1: The compact-weapon column contains more than the three common battlefield choices.
levels.2: Cycle the secondary slot at the pre-mission loadout screen and also pick up any enemy-only launcher.
levels.3: Use the Thompson and MP40 first, then test the PPSh-41, Błyskawica, and MP44 in live maps. Separately collect and fire a Panzerfaust where a map supplies one; the launcher is not a reusable pre-mission choice.

levels.1: Compare the silent choices with the conventional sidearms.
levels.2: Cycle every available pistol in the loadout screen, then collect enemy sidearms if one is not selectable there.
levels.3: Test the Welrod and HDM, then the Colt M1911 and Luger P08. Finish with the Webley Mk VI and Tokarev TT-33. Fire and reload every sidearm; if one appears only as a drop, use the floor-level swap prompt before testing it.

levels.1: Each deployable behaves differently around patrols and vehicles.
levels.2: Equip or collect grenades, trip mines, land mines, and dynamite during replayable maps.
levels.3: Detonate an M24 grenade, an F-1 grenade, a trip mine, a land mine, and dynamite. For placed charges, move outside the blast radius and trigger them with their intended victim or a rifle shot; replenish from crates or restart the map if the carried supply is exhausted.

levels.1: Two non-loadout interactions finish the equipment tour.
levels.2: Find a mounted MG42 and use rocks plus the knife during any campaign replay.
levels.3: Fire a mounted MG42, throw a rock far enough to redirect a patrol, and perform a close stealth takedown with the knife. These interactions are map equipment or context actions rather than permanent loadout unlocks.

areas.name: Two-Player Cooperative Modes
areas.location_cue: The Cooperative menu, which separates campaign, wave, repair, and paired-role missions.
areas.note: All four cooperative modes require a second player; private sessions are suitable and no console-only local feature is part of this Windows route.

levels.1: A partner changes revives, but not the objective structure.
levels.2: Choose Campaign from the Cooperative menu and clear every available mission with two players.
levels.3: Host or join a private two-player Campaign lobby, complete all eleven base maps and four bundled challenge maps, revive either player when downed, and remain together until each extraction registers. Use Sniper Elite difficulty for the hardest-route row at the same time.

levels.1: Treat the ammunition point as the center of a ten-wave defense.
levels.2: Select Kill Tally and survive all ten waves on each of its five selectable maps.
levels.3: With two players, clear ten waves on every map shown in the Kill Tally selector. Share the infinite resupply point, trap vehicle approaches before later waves, preserve one safe revive lane, and do not leave when a wave counter is still active.

levels.1: Search first; the strict timer begins near the end of the repair list.
levels.2: Complete all three Bombing Run maps by returning every required vehicle part.
levels.3: Split the search and recover the five-to-seven components marked for the escape vehicle. The clock changes to five minutes after the team has reduced the list to its last two parts; regroup, install both, board the repaired vehicle, and repeat on all three maps.

items.label: Finish every Overwatch map in both roles

levels.1: The ground operative and elevated sniper see different halves of each solution.
levels.2: Clear all five Overwatch maps once as Operative and once as Sniper.
levels.3: As Operative, use binoculars to tag threats and perform the ground objectives; as Sniper, remain in the restricted firing area and remove those tagged threats. Finish every objective and extraction on all five maps, swap roles, then repeat the complete set.

save_backup.title: Keep a completed solo-profile backup
save_backup.why: Co-op depends on another player's connection and a host session.
save_backup.detail: Preserve the solo-complete profile before starting online cleanup so disconnects cannot complicate the verified local baseline.

areas.name: Competitive Multiplayer
areas.location_cue: The online browser and private-lobby setup for the remaster's seven competitive rulesets.
areas.note: These rows require other players and server availability. They are online modes, not permanently missable campaign content.

levels.1: Use a private lobby if public matchmaking does not expose this ruleset quickly.
levels.2: Create or join a lobby using Deathmatch, then remain through the results screen.
levels.3: Score by eliminating opponents; the highest individual kill total wins. Set a short score or time limit in a private lobby, play until that limit is reached, and wait for the final results table before changing modes. Repeat on every map the lobby exposes for this ruleset.

levels.1: Use a private lobby if public matchmaking does not expose this ruleset quickly.
levels.2: Create or join a lobby using Team Deathmatch, then remain through the results screen.
levels.3: Work with one side and finish with the higher combined elimination score. Set a short score or time limit in a private lobby, play until that limit is reached, and wait for the final results table before changing modes. Repeat on every map the lobby exposes for this ruleset.

levels.1: Use a private lobby if public matchmaking does not expose this ruleset quickly.
levels.2: Create or join a lobby using Distance King, then remain through the results screen.
levels.3: Individual score comes from the range of successful shots rather than the raw elimination count. Set a short score or time limit in a private lobby, play until that limit is reached, and wait for the final results table before changing modes. Repeat on every map the lobby exposes for this ruleset.

levels.1: Use a private lobby if public matchmaking does not expose this ruleset quickly.
levels.2: Create or join a lobby using Team Distance King, then remain through the results screen.
levels.3: Combine long-range scoring with teammates and finish above the opposing distance total. Set a short score or time limit in a private lobby, play until that limit is reached, and wait for the final results table before changing modes. Repeat on every map the lobby exposes for this ruleset.

levels.1: Use a private lobby if public matchmaking does not expose this ruleset quickly.
levels.2: Create or join a lobby using Dogtag Harvest, then remain through the results screen.
levels.3: An elimination only becomes score after someone collects the dropped tag. Set a short score or time limit in a private lobby, play until that limit is reached, and wait for the final results table before changing modes. Repeat on every map the lobby exposes for this ruleset.

levels.1: Use a private lobby if public matchmaking does not expose this ruleset quickly.
levels.2: Create or join a lobby using Team Dogtag Harvest, then remain through the results screen.
levels.3: Collect friendly and opposing tags while protecting the team's running score. Set a short score or time limit in a private lobby, play until that limit is reached, and wait for the final results table before changing modes. Repeat on every map the lobby exposes for this ruleset.

levels.1: Use a private lobby if public matchmaking does not expose this ruleset quickly.
levels.2: Create or join a lobby using Capture the Flag, then remain through the results screen.
levels.3: Take the opposing flag to the home scoring point while keeping your own flag available. Set a short score or time limit in a private lobby, play until that limit is reached, and wait for the final results table before changing modes. Repeat on every map the lobby exposes for this ruleset.

save_backup.detail: Keep the post-campaign backup until all seven rulesets have reached a results screen.
